requiredBeforeVectorsMayBeAdded: A human H01 reviewer must approve an independently implemented, non-Rust validator adapter and record its identity, version, source, license, and invocation in ADR-0003 before its output can count as evidence.

The reviewer must approve a documented test-only vector generation procedure that takes the frozen contract's exact canonical AAD bytes and emits each 32-byte wrapped key as XChaCha20-Poly1305 ciphertext || 16-byte tag (48 bytes total). This is an application-fixture procedure, not an authoritative external wrapper-vector source.

The adapter must independently encrypt and decrypt every positive case and reject wrong wrapping key, wrong kind, changed account/vault/item identifier, changed key version, and changed nonce/ciphertext/tag without returning wrapped-key bytes.

Each resulting vector must carry source/procedure provenance, fixture-format revision, test-only classification, and SHA-256 of its normalized record; the H01 reviewer must record the independent result digest and disposition.
No production library selection, contract change, or production crypto implementation is authorized by this blocker record.
